name: Skill_by_Satya
description: Reusable meta-skill: establish, bootstrap, maintain, and evolve an intelligent skill-routing environment (skill discovery + routing + command resolution) in any agent repository. Works whether the target repo has zero skills or fifty.

router_help: how does the skill router work

commands.name: bootstrap
commands.description: Establish the routing environment: create skills/ and the registry, generate candidate manifests for skills that lack one, install skill.py, and append the agent.md maintenance contract. Idempotent and conservative.

commands.name: sync
commands.description: Idempotent synchronization: rebuild the registry from manifests, validate everything, report orphan skills.

commands.name: list
commands.description: Print the skill index: every routable skill and its commands.

commands.name: route
commands.description: Route a user request to the best skill + command; print the structured result.

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate all manifests and the registry; exit 0/1.
